title: The Wedding of Anakin and Padmé
front_description: Far removed from current politics and future fears, Anakin Skywalker escorts Padmé Amidala back to Naboo. Soon they are standing before a holy man in a garden of roses, vowing to love one another for all time. Droids Threepio and Artoo stand off to the side, watching this lovely marriage ceremony. And as their union is blessed by the priest, amid gently falling rose petals, Anakin and Padmé kiss.
back_description: Anakin's fully-functional "Artificial Hand" prop, glimpsed briefly at movie's end.
